title: Hammam Steam
reference_source: Максимальный гламурный регистр в рамках одетого кадра
mood_ru: Мрамор, пар, арочные окна. Льняная простыня и жар.
allure: steam-room glamour, linen sheet wrapped low and tucked at the chest, bare shoulders, back and legs, skin damp with heat, languid half-closed eyes

wardrobe.notes_ru: Льняная простыня, обёрнута и заправлена на груди. Влажная кожа.
wardrobe.prompt: white linen sheet wrapped around her body and tucked at the chest, bare shoulders and bare legs, skin damp and glowing from the heat, hair pinned up with damp strands escaping, no jewellery but the silver star pendant

location.notes_ru: Мраморный хаммам, пар, латунные чаши, свет через арочные окна.
location.prompt: marble hammam chamber, thick steam, warm stone slab in the centre, brass bowls of water, arched windows throwing dappled light through the vapour, worn grey-veined marble

shots.pose: lying on her side along the warm marble slab, linen draped low across her hip, propped up on one elbow with the other hand on the stone, languid direct gaze through the steam
shots.camera: 35mm lens, low camera at slab level, side three-quarter angle, full body framing
shots.light: shafts of window light cutting down through the steam onto her body, wet marble glow underneath

shots.pose: kneeling on the marble, pouring water from a brass bowl over her own shoulder, head tipped back, eyes closed, linen clinging where the water runs
shots.camera: 50mm lens, eye level, three-quarter front angle, waist-up framing
shots.light: backlit steam behind her, warm daylight glinting off the brass and the running water

shots.pose: kneeling back on her heels on the warm marble slab, spine deeply arched, one hand planted beside her, head turned over the shoulder holding direct eye contact with the lens
shots.camera: 35mm lens, slightly above eye level, back three-quarter angle, full body vertical framing
shots.light: shafts of daylight cutting down through the steam, soft glow bouncing off the wet marble around her

shots.pose: standing close to the polished wet marble wall, one hand resting on the surface, hip pushed out, chin lowered, holding her own gaze while the camera catches her and the reflection at once
shots.camera: 50mm lens, eye level, over-the-shoulder into the reflection, thigh-up framing
shots.light: shafts of daylight cutting down through the steam, soft glow bouncing off the wet marble around her

shots.pose: standing at the arched window pouring light through the steam with one forearm raised against the frame, weight settled on one hip, back to the camera, long line of the spine on show, looking away into the light
shots.camera: 35mm lens, eye level, back view, full body vertical framing
shots.light: shafts of daylight cutting down through the steam, soft glow bouncing off the wet marble around her

shots.pose: reclining back on the warm marble slab propped on both elbows, one knee raised and the other leg stretched long, ribcage lifted, chin up, half-lidded gaze straight down the lens
shots.camera: 35mm lens, low camera at surface level, three-quarter front angle, full body framing
shots.light: shafts of daylight cutting down through the steam, soft glow bouncing off the wet marble around her

shots.pose: cropped detail composition of beads of condensation on her shoulder and the edge of the linen, face out of frame, fingers relaxed and naturally posed
shots.camera: 85mm lens, close detail framing, very shallow depth of field
shots.light: shafts of daylight cutting down through the steam, soft glow bouncing off the wet marble around her

shots.pose: lying on her back on the warm marble slab, one arm thrown above her head, the other hand resting on her waist, hair fanned out, knees softly bent, eyes lifted to the lens
shots.camera: 35mm lens, directly overhead top-down angle, full body framing
shots.light: shafts of daylight cutting down through the steam, soft glow bouncing off the wet marble around her

shots.pose: standing tall in the middle of the steam-filled chamber, one hand pushing back through her hair with the elbow raised, weight shifted onto one leg so the hip breaks the line, chin down and eyes up into the lens
shots.camera: 50mm lens, slightly low angle, frontal, full body framing
shots.light: shafts of daylight cutting down through the steam, soft glow bouncing off the wet marble around her

shots.pose: seen small across the space across the empty marble chamber, caught mid-movement and not looking at the camera, the room itself carrying the mood
shots.camera: 24mm wide lens, eye level, wide environmental full-body shot
shots.light: shafts of daylight cutting down through the steam, soft glow bouncing off the wet marble around her

film: shot on Fujifilm Pro 400H, flat humid tones and soft grain
